visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Delete removes the wrong item
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Pressing the delete button of Write removes Read, the first item, instead. The handler removes a fixed item instead of the one that was pressed.
visualizerParams.buggyCode:
• Read
  • Write

solution.code:
• Read
  • Write
solution.explanation: querySelector always returns the first match, so the first item is removed whichever button was pressed. Use the pressed button's own parent: b.parentElement.

checks.label: Deleting the second item removes Write
